NGO Registration.shortDescription: Complete assistance registering your NGO as a trust, society, or Section 8 company.
NGO Registration.longDescription: We help you choose the right structure — trust, society, or Section 8 company — and manage documentation and registration filing for your non-profit organization.
benefits: Legal recognition for your social mission
Access to grants and donor funding
requirements: Objects and activities of the NGO

faqs.question: Which structure is best for an NGO?
faqs.answer: Depends on scale and governance preference; trusts and societies are simpler, Section 8 companies offer more credibility.

faqs.question: How many founders are needed?
faqs.answer: Minimum varies: 2 for trusts, 7 for societies, 2 for Section 8 companies.

faqs.question: Is tax exemption automatic on registration?
faqs.answer: No, separate 12A/80G registration is required for tax benefits.

Trust Registration.shortDescription: Assistance in drafting trust deeds and completing statutory trust registration formalities.
Trust Registration.longDescription: We draft a comprehensive trust deed outlining objectives, trustees, and governance, and manage registration with the relevant sub-registrar.
benefits: Legal recognition as a charitable trust

process.title: Deed Drafting
process.description: Prepare the trust deed with objects and rules.

process.title: Execution
process.description: Execute the deed with stamp duty payment.

process.title: Registration
process.description: Register the deed with the sub-registrar.

faqs.question: How many trustees are required?
faqs.answer: At least two trustees are generally recommended.

faqs.question: Is trust registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, for legal recognition and to hold immovable property.

faqs.question: Can a trust deed be amended later?
faqs.answer: Yes, through a supplementary deed if the original deed permits amendments.

Society Registration.shortDescription: Complete support for society registration including memorandum, rules, and formalities.
Society Registration.longDescription: We draft the memorandum of association and rules and regulations, then manage registration filing with the Registrar of Societies.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit to the Registrar of Societies.

faqs.question: How many members are needed for a society?
faqs.answer: A minimum of 7 members is generally required.

faqs.question: Is annual filing required for societies?
faqs.answer: Yes, most states require annual list-of-members filing.

faqs.question: Can a society own property?
faqs.answer: Yes, once registered, it can hold property in its own name.

Section 8 Company Registration.shortDescription: Complete assistance registering NGOs as Section 8 companies with documentation and legal compliance.
Section 8 Company Registration.longDescription: Section 8 companies offer strong governance and credibility for larger NGOs. We manage name approval, licensing, and incorporation filing with MCA.

process.title: Name & License
process.description: Obtain name approval and Section 8 license.

process.title: Document Drafting
process.description: Prepare MOA, AOA, and SPICe+ forms.

process.title: Incorporation
process.description: File with MCA and receive certificate.

faqs.question: Can Section 8 companies distribute profits?
faqs.answer: No, all profits must be applied toward the company's charitable objects.

faqs.question: How many directors are required?
faqs.answer: A minimum of two directors for a private Section 8 company.

faqs.question: Is a license required before incorporation?
faqs.answer: Yes, an INC-12 license is required as part of the incorporation process.

NGO PAN Registration.shortDescription: Obtain a Permanent Account Number for your NGO entity for tax and banking purposes.
NGO PAN Registration.longDescription: PAN is essential for NGO banking, tax filings, and donor transactions. We manage the application process for your trust, society, or Section 8 company.

process.title: Application Filing
process.description: Submit PAN application for the entity.

faqs.question: Is PAN mandatory for NGOs?
faqs.answer: Yes, for tax filing, banking, and receiving donations.

faqs.question: Can PAN be applied for before registration is complete?
faqs.answer: No, the entity must first be legally registered.

faqs.question: Does PAN differ by NGO structure?
faqs.answer: No, the application process is similar across trusts, societies, and companies.

NGO TAN Registration.shortDescription: Obtain TAN for your NGO to enable compliant TDS deduction on payments made.
NGO TAN Registration.longDescription: NGOs making payments subject to TDS need a TAN. We manage the application and registration process for compliant deduction and filing.
benefits: Enables lawful TDS deduction by the NGO
Avoids penalty for non-possession of TAN

faqs.question: Do all NGOs need a TAN?
faqs.answer: Only if they are required to deduct TDS on payments made.

faqs.question: What payments commonly attract TDS for NGOs?
faqs.answer: Staff salaries, professional fees, and contractor payments above thresholds.

faqs.question: Is TAN separate from 12A/80G registration?
faqs.answer: Yes, TAN relates to TDS compliance, not tax exemption status.

12A Registration.shortDescription: Register under Section 12A to exempt your NGO's income from taxation.
12A Registration.longDescription: 12A registration exempts the NGO's income from tax, subject to application-of-income conditions. We manage documentation and application filing.

process.title: Approval
process.description: Respond to queries and secure registration.

faqs.question: Is 12A registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: Not mandatory, but essential to claim income tax exemption.

faqs.question: How long is 12A registration valid?
faqs.answer: 5 years under the current regime, requiring renewal thereafter.

faqs.question: Can 12A be denied?
faqs.answer: Yes, if objects aren't genuinely charitable or documentation is inadequate.

80G Registration.shortDescription: Register under Section 80G to enable donors to claim tax deduction on donations to your NGO.
80G Registration.longDescription: 80G registration significantly boosts donor interest by allowing tax deduction on contributions. We manage application and compliance for this registration.

process.title: Approval
process.description: Respond to queries and secure registration.

faqs.question: Is 12A required before applying for 80G?
faqs.answer: Yes, 12A registration is a prerequisite for 80G.

faqs.question: How much deduction can donors claim?
faqs.answer: Typically 50% of the donation, subject to conditions and limits.

faqs.question: Is 80G registration permanent?
faqs.answer: No, it requires periodic renewal, currently every 5 years.

12AB Registration.shortDescription: Complete the revised 12AB registration process required under the updated exemption regime.
12AB Registration.longDescription: 12AB replaced the older 12A/12AA registration system with a time-bound renewal process. We manage provisional and regular registration applications.
benefits: Compliant with the current exemption regime

process.title: Status Assessment
process.description: Determine provisional or regular registration need.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 12A and 12AB?
faqs.answer: 12AB is the current time-bound registration replacing the older permanent 12A/12AA system.

faqs.question: How often must 12AB be renewed?
faqs.answer: Every 5 years, or as specified for provisional registrations.

faqs.question: What happens if renewal is missed?
faqs.answer: Exemption status may lapse, requiring fresh registration.

NGO Annual Compliance.shortDescription: Manage your NGO's complete annual compliance including filings and governance requirements.
NGO Annual Compliance.longDescription: We handle the full annual compliance cycle for your NGO — income tax filing, audit coordination, and structure-specific statutory requirements.
features: Income tax return and audit report filing
benefits: Single point of annual compliance management

faqs.question: What are key NGO annual compliances?
faqs.answer: ITR-7 filing, audit report (Form 10B/10BB), and structure-specific returns.

faqs.question: Is audit mandatory for all NGOs?
faqs.answer: Yes, if income before exemption exceeds the basic exemption limit.

faqs.question: What happens on non-compliance?
faqs.answer: Risk of exemption withdrawal and penalty for late filing.

NGO Income Tax Return.shortDescription: Preparation and filing of income tax returns for NGOs with applicable exemptions.
NGO Income Tax Return.longDescription: We prepare accurate ITR-7 filings for your NGO, considering exemption conditions, application of income, and accumulation provisions.

faqs.question: What is the due date for NGO ITR filing?
faqs.answer: 31st October if audit applies, otherwise 31st July.

faqs.question: What is application of income?
faqs.answer: The portion of income spent on charitable objects required to retain exemption.

faqs.question: Can unspent income be carried forward?
faqs.answer: Yes, through accumulation provisions under Section 11(2), subject to conditions.

NGO Audit.shortDescription: Conduct statutory NGO audits and prepare Form 10B/10BB as required for exemption compliance.
NGO Audit.longDescription: We conduct the mandatory audit of your NGO's accounts and prepare the applicable audit report, ensuring compliance with exemption conditions.

process.title: Audit Execution
process.description: Verify books and prepare the audit report.

faqs.question: When is NGO audit mandatory?
faqs.answer: When income before exemption exceeds the basic exemption limit.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 10B and 10BB?
faqs.answer: Applicability depends on the level of income and specific conditions under the rules.

faqs.question: What is the due date for the audit report?
faqs.answer: At least one month before the ITR due date.

NGO Darpan Registration.shortDescription: Register your NGO on the NGO Darpan portal to access government schemes and grants.
NGO Darpan Registration.longDescription: NGO Darpan registration is required for NGOs seeking government funding and partnerships. We manage the application and documentation process.

faqs.question: Is NGO Darpan registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: It is mandatory for NGOs seeking government grants or FCRA registration.

faqs.question: Is there a fee for registration?
faqs.answer: The government portal registration itself is free.

faqs.question: Can I update NGO details later?
faqs.answer: Yes, the profile can be updated as organizational details change.

FCRA Registration.shortDescription: Obtain FCRA registration to legally receive foreign contributions for your NGO.
FCRA Registration.longDescription: FCRA registration is mandatory to accept foreign donations. We manage eligibility assessment, documentation, and application filing with the Ministry of Home Affairs.
benefits: Legal authorization to receive foreign funding

process.title: Eligibility Review
process.description: Confirm track record and compliance history.

process.title: Approval
process.description: Track MHA processing and secure registration.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for FCRA registration?
faqs.answer: Generally 3 years of existence with substantial charitable activity.

faqs.question: Where must foreign funds be received?
faqs.answer: Only in the designated FCRA account at the specified SBI branch.

faqs.question: How long is FCRA registration valid?
faqs.answer: 5 years, renewable thereafter.

FCRA Prior Permission.shortDescription: Obtain FCRA prior permission for newer NGOs to receive foreign contributions for specific projects.
FCRA Prior Permission.longDescription: NGOs not yet eligible for full FCRA registration can apply for prior permission to receive foreign funds for a specific project or donor.
benefits: Enables foreign funding before full FCRA eligibility

process.title: Approval
process.description: Track MHA processing and secure permission.

faqs.question: Who needs prior permission instead of registration?
faqs.answer: NGOs with less than 3 years of operation or specific project-based funding.

faqs.question: Is prior permission project-specific?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's limited to the specific project and donor named in the application.

faqs.question: Can prior permission lead to full registration later?
faqs.answer: Yes, once eligibility criteria for full registration are met.

FCRA Annual Return.shortDescription: Prepare and file mandatory annual FCRA returns disclosing foreign contribution utilization.
FCRA Annual Return.longDescription: FCRA-registered NGOs must file Form FC-4 annually, disclosing receipts and utilization of foreign contributions. We manage accurate preparation and filing.

faqs.question: What is the due date for FC-4?
faqs.answer: 31st December following the financial year.

faqs.question: Is nil return required if no foreign funds received?
faqs.answer: Yes, a nil FC-4 must still be filed.

faqs.question: What happens on non-filing?
faqs.answer: Penalty and risk of FCRA registration cancellation.

FCRA Compliance.shortDescription: Ongoing FCRA compliance management covering utilization rules, reporting, and regulatory updates.
FCRA Compliance.longDescription: We provide continuous FCRA compliance support, tracking utilization limits, administrative expense caps, and evolving regulatory requirements.
benefits: Peace of mind for foreign-funded NGOs

faqs.question: What is the admin expense cap under FCRA?
faqs.answer: Currently capped at 20% of foreign contribution utilized.

faqs.question: Can FCRA funds be transferred to other NGOs?
faqs.answer: No, transfer of foreign contribution to other persons/entities is prohibited.

faqs.question: What triggers FCRA suspension?
faqs.answer: Violations of utilization rules, reporting failures, or fund misuse.

NGO 10BD Filing.shortDescription: File Form 10BD reporting details of donations received to enable donor tax deduction claims.
NGO 10BD Filing.longDescription: Form 10BD is a statement of donations received, required for donors to claim 80G deduction. We compile donor data and file accurately within the deadline.

process.title: Filing
process.description: Submit the form before the deadline.

faqs.question: What is the due date for Form 10BD?
faqs.answer: 31st May following the financial year.

faqs.question: Is this required for all donations received?
faqs.answer: Yes, for all donations eligible for 80G deduction by donors.

faqs.question: What happens on non-filing?
faqs.answer: A penalty applies and donors cannot claim deduction without Form 10BE.

NGO 10BE Certificate.shortDescription: Generate and issue Form 10BE donation certificates to donors after 10BD filing.
NGO 10BE Certificate.longDescription: Once Form 10BD is filed, Form 10BE certificates must be issued to donors as proof for their 80G deduction claims. We manage generation and distribution.

faqs.question: Can 10BE be issued without filing 10BD?
faqs.answer: No, 10BE generation depends on the filed Form 10BD.

faqs.question: By when should 10BE be issued to donors?
faqs.answer: By 31st May following the financial year.

faqs.question: Is 10BE mandatory for donor deduction?
faqs.answer: Yes, it serves as the required proof for claiming 80G deduction.

Donation Documentation.shortDescription: Set up systematic donation receipt and documentation processes for your NGO.
Donation Documentation.longDescription: We help design donation receipt formats, record-keeping systems, and compliance-ready documentation to streamline donor management.
requirements: Current donation tracking method, if any

process.title: System Design
process.description: Design receipt formats and tracking systems.

process.title: Implementation Guidance
process.description: Support rollout of the new system.

faqs.question: What must a donation receipt include?
faqs.answer: NGO name, PAN, 80G registration number, donor details, and amount.

faqs.question: Should cash donations be documented differently?
faqs.answer: Cash donations above ₹2,000 are not eligible for 80G deduction.

faqs.question: Is digital record-keeping acceptable?
faqs.answer: Yes, digital systems are acceptable provided records remain accurate and retrievable.

CSR-1 Registration.shortDescription: Register your NGO under CSR-1 to become eligible for corporate CSR funding.
CSR-1 Registration.longDescription: CSR-1 registration is mandatory for NGOs seeking CSR funds from companies. We manage documentation and filing for this registration.
benefits: Access to a broader funding base

process.title: Approval
process.description: Receive the unique CSR registration number.

faqs.question: Is CSR-1 mandatory for receiving CSR funds?
faqs.answer: Yes, since 2021 it is mandatory for NGOs implementing CSR projects.

faqs.question: What entities are eligible for CSR-1?
faqs.answer: Registered trusts, societies, and Section 8 companies with the required track record.

faqs.question: Does CSR-1 replace 80G registration?
faqs.answer: No, both serve different purposes and may be required together.

CSR Compliance.shortDescription: Manage CSR project compliance and reporting requirements for NGOs implementing CSR funds.
CSR Compliance.longDescription: We help NGOs manage CSR fund utilization tracking, reporting, and compliance documentation required by corporate CSR partners.
benefits: Builds trust with corporate CSR donors

process.title: Project Setup
process.description: Establish tracking framework for the CSR project.

process.title: Reporting
process.description: Prepare periodic reports for the CSR partner.

faqs.question: How often is CSR reporting required?
faqs.answer: Typically per the agreement, often quarterly or annually.

faqs.question: What happens if funds aren't utilized as agreed?
faqs.answer: It can affect future funding and require corrective reporting.

faqs.question: Do NGOs need separate accounting for CSR funds?
faqs.answer: Yes, segregated tracking is strongly recommended for transparency.

NGO Grant Compliance.shortDescription: Manage compliance requirements tied to government and institutional grants received by your NGO.
NGO Grant Compliance.longDescription: We help NGOs track utilization, reporting deadlines, and conditions attached to grants from government bodies and institutional donors.

faqs.question: What is a utilization certificate?
faqs.answer: A statement confirming grant funds were used for the sanctioned purpose.

faqs.question: What happens on non-compliance with grant terms?
faqs.answer: Grants may be recovered or future funding denied.

faqs.question: Is separate accounting needed for each grant?
faqs.answer: Yes, to accurately track utilization against each grant's conditions.

NGO Funding Documentation.shortDescription: Prepare comprehensive documentation to support NGO funding applications and donor due diligence.
NGO Funding Documentation.longDescription: We help compile organizational, financial, and compliance documentation that funders typically require before approving grants or donations.
features: Financial statement and audit report organization
benefits: Faster response to donor due-diligence requests

process.title: Finalization
process.description: Prepare a ready-to-share funding documentation packet.

faqs.question: What do funders typically request?
faqs.answer: Registration certificates, audited financials, and project impact reports.

faqs.question: Is this useful for international funders too?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially alongside FCRA compliance documentation.

faqs.question: How often should this be updated?
faqs.answer: Annually, or before each major funding application.

NGO Books of Accounts.shortDescription: Maintain accurate books of accounts for your NGO covering income, expenses, and fund utilization.
NGO Books of Accounts.longDescription: We set up and maintain systematic bookkeeping for your NGO, ensuring accurate tracking of donations, grants, and expenditures for compliance and reporting.

process.title: Setup
process.description: Establish chart of accounts and ledgers.

faqs.question: Why separate restricted and unrestricted funds?
faqs.answer: To accurately track grant-specific utilization against overall NGO funds.

faqs.question: Is bookkeeping different for NGOs vs businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes, fund accounting principles differ from standard commercial accounting.

faqs.question: How often should books be updated?
faqs.answer: Monthly is recommended for accuracy and audit readiness.

NGO Financial Statements.shortDescription: Prepare accurate financial statements for your NGO covering income, expenditure, and balance sheet.
NGO Financial Statements.longDescription: We prepare NGO-specific financial statements including income and expenditure account, balance sheet, and receipts and payments account.
benefits: Clear presentation for donors and auditors
Supports ITR and audit report filing

process.title: Data Compilation
process.description: Gather transaction records for the period.

process.title: Statement Preparation
process.description: Prepare financial statements as per NGO norms.

faqs.question: What statements are prepared for NGOs?
faqs.answer: Income & expenditure account, balance sheet, and receipts & payments account.

faqs.question: Are these needed for audit?
faqs.answer: Yes, they form the basis for the statutory audit report.

faqs.question: How often should statements be prepared?
faqs.answer: Annually, aligned with the financial year.

NGO Tax Exemption Advisory.shortDescription: Advisory on maintaining and optimizing tax exemption status for your NGO.
NGO Tax Exemption Advisory.longDescription: We provide ongoing guidance on application-of-income rules, accumulation provisions, and conditions to sustain your NGO's tax exemption status.

faqs.question: What can jeopardize exemption status?
faqs.answer: Excess commercial activity, inadequate application of income, or violation of conditions.

faqs.question: What is Section 11(2) accumulation?
faqs.answer: A provision allowing NGOs to accumulate unspent income for specified future purposes.

faqs.question: Can exemption be restored if withdrawn?
faqs.answer: It requires fresh registration and remedial compliance, which can be challenging.

NGO Compliance Audit.shortDescription: Comprehensive review of your NGO's overall statutory and regulatory compliance status.
NGO Compliance Audit.longDescription: We conduct a proactive compliance audit covering registration status, tax exemption conditions, FCRA compliance, and governance practices.

process.title: Scope Definition
process.description: Define audit areas and compliance scope.

faqs.question: How often should this audit be done?
faqs.answer: Annually, especially before major grant applications.

faqs.question: Is this different from the statutory financial audit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a broader compliance review, not just financial statement audit.

faqs.question: What areas does it typically cover?
faqs.answer: Registrations, tax filings, FCRA (if applicable), and governance documentation.

NGO Legal Documentation.shortDescription: Prepare and review legal documents for NGOs including agreements, policies, and resolutions.
NGO Legal Documentation.longDescription: We draft and review various NGO legal documents — MOUs, project agreements, HR policies, and governing body resolutions — ensuring legal soundness.
benefits: Reduced risk of disputes with partners/staff

faqs.question: What documents do NGOs commonly need?
faqs.answer: MOUs with partners, employment contracts, and project agreements, among others.

faqs.question: Are governing body resolutions always required?
faqs.answer: For significant decisions, yes, to maintain proper governance records.

faqs.question: Can existing templates be reviewed instead of fresh drafting?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can review and improve existing documents as needed.

NGO Closure & Dissolution.shortDescription: Manage the legal process of closing or dissolving an NGO in compliance with applicable laws.
NGO Closure & Dissolution.longDescription: NGO dissolution requires following the process specified in the founding document and applicable law, including asset transfer to similar organizations.

process.title: Process Review
process.description: Review dissolution provisions in founding document.

process.title: Resolution & Asset Transfer
process.description: Pass resolution and arrange asset transfer.

faqs.question: Can NGO assets be distributed to members?
faqs.answer: No, assets must generally be transferred to another similar charitable organization.

faqs.question: Is court/authority approval needed for dissolution?
faqs.answer: Often yes, particularly for societies and Section 8 companies.

faqs.question: What happens to pending liabilities?
faqs.answer: These must be settled before the dissolution process is completed.
